name: match_type_spatial_count
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM permit_parcels WHERE match_type = 'spatial'

name: duplicate_permit_pair_count
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT permit_num, revision_num FROM permit_parcels GROUP BY permit_num, revision_num HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) d

name: match_type_exact_address_count
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM permit_parcels WHERE match_type = 'exact_address'

name: match_type_address_points_exact_count
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM permit_parcels WHERE match_type = 'address_points_exact'

name: match_type_spatial_polygon_count
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM permit_parcels WHERE match_type = 'spatial_polygon'

name: match_type_name_only_count
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM permit_parcels WHERE match_type = 'name_only'

name: permits_parcel_linked_at_not_null
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM permits WHERE parcel_linked_at IS NOT NULL
